verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs say GitHub Actions automates and executes software development workflows 'right in your repository', and the product claims CI/CD. Community comments treat Actions as a core, metered CI/CD feature. The evidence does not explicitly document workflow-as-code definition files or automatic triggering on pushes and pull requests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pipeline definitions as code (e.g. workflow files) and of push/pull-request event triggers, plus independent hands-on corroboration of automatic runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define CI/CD pipelines as code in my repository and have them run automatically on pushes and pull requests

citations.quote: Automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository with GitHub Actions.
Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD.
GitHub CLI is a command-line tool that brings pull requests, issues, GitHub Actions, and other GitHub features to your terminal
